sentence: This project builds an algorithm that reassembles an object from its fragments and tests it on 3D scans of pottery and bone fragments.
This project tries to find out why so many closely related strains of bacteria live together, using simple models and DNA sequencing.
This project builds models and tools that help freight operators recover when disruptions spread across road, rail and waterway networks.
This project builds ultrathin computing systems that use light to run artificial intelligence tasks while using less energy.
This project studies the ices in the disks of gas and dust around young stars, using laboratory experiments, machine learning and observations.
This project develops an x-ray source made of many small sources, to build lighter and cheaper scanners that make 3D images.
This project tests a program that helps elementary school teachers teach cybersecurity inside mathematics and science lessons.
This project designs peptide-based nanomaterials by making large peptide macrocycles that join together through coiled coil interactions.
This project develops a mathematical framework that uses graph limits to study how large groups of interacting agents behave and learn.
This project studies how the brain of monkeys keeps track of the order of items in a sequence, by recording brain activity.
This project studies ways to keep computer systems and shared data secure, using cybersecurity, data analytics and blockchain.
This project studies how to protect energy systems, from energy generation to storage and power transmission, using artificial intelligence and cybersecurity.
This project studies matter under pressures so high that they change atoms, as found inside planets and stars, using powerful lasers and x-ray beams.
This project develops an image-guided system that solidifies after injection into a tumor and releases biologic therapies slowly.
This project studies why designers copy elements of example designs they have seen, comparing industrial designers with mechanical engineers using behavior and brain imaging.
This project builds a system that helps home robots learn skills from human guidance and combine them to do longer tasks using planning.
This project supports computer simulations of how electrons and nuclei move together in materials, combined with machine learning.
This project builds tools that use artificial intelligence to give string music performers feedback and to stand in for missing players.
